items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: I went up there with Tommy Chase

ctx.x: In June 1941 you went to Long Branch, New Jersey. Tell us about that. What brought you up there? Were you still married at that time?
Yeah. I went up there with Tommy Chase -- this guy around here named Chase. He's dead now. A piano player. He played piano and trumpet.
He took a band up there?
